scripts.build: npm run build -w @firelaunch/contracts && npm run build -w @firelaunch/channel-engine && npm run build -w @firelaunch/tv && npm run build -w @firelaunch/generator && npm run build -w @firelaunch/agent && npm run build -w @firelaunch/server && npm run build -w @firelaunch/studio
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @firelaunch/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @firelaunch/channel-engine && npm run typecheck -w @firelaunch/tv && npm run typecheck -w @firelaunch/generator && npm run typecheck -w @firelaunch/agent && npm run typecheck -w @firelaunch/server && npm run typecheck -w @firelaunch/studio
scripts.test:kernel: npm run build && node --import tsx --test packages/contracts/test/*.test.ts packages/channel-engine/test/*.test.ts packages/tv/test/*.test.ts packages/generator/test/*.test.ts packages/agent/test/*.test.ts apps/server/test/*.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:kernel && npm run test:studio && npm run test:runner
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
